serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Are you alright, {f_playerName}? Did something happen?
You: N-No, not really… {{wi}}I’m just in a bad mood…{{wi}} That’s all really.
Bot: Oh… {{wi}}If you say so.
Bot: Remember {f_playerName}, I’m always here for you. You can talk to me any time you want. 
You: Thanks {f_botName}. 
I feel a little bit better right now.
